svg.text: The same simulated scenario on every fifth held-out seed (100–135), at H8's decision: his key scan (gold cone), his pass with it (gold arrow)
and the same seconds re-simulated without it (dashed; a dashed ring when he keeps the ball). H9, the runner, in gold. Synthetic players, fictional teams.
